szenen.text: Warning. For weeks now, Trust Wallet users have been waking up to empty wallets.
On-chain investigators at Bitquery traced over five point four million dollars in USDT drained from reported wallets since early October.
The biggest single hit: on November seventh, one wallet untouched since 2021 lost six hundred and one thousand USDT in one evening.

foto.unter: CZ warns of a fake Trust Wallet site

szenen.text: CZ himself warned about a fake Trust Wallet site. Dot cam is not dot com.
Fake sites like this ask for your recovery phrase. Type it in, and your wallet is gone.
The cause of the other drains? Nobody knows yet. Trust Wallet has not confirmed a flaw. Many victims were on iPhones.
Our advice: be careful. Big money does not belong in a phone wallet. Move it to a hardware wallet. Update your phone, revoke old approvals, and never type your seed phrase anywhere.
